name: Omega X Converter Agent Tooling
description: Deterministic SI metrology and unit conversion engine with 28 physical categories and 123 verified canonical pairs. Designed for autonomous agents, answer engines, and LLM tool calling.

info.title: NumanX Omega Metrology Engine
info.description: Universal unit conversion interface supporting SI, US Customary, Imperial, and scientific domains.

metrology_standards: NIST Special Publication 811 (Guide for the Use of the International System of Units)
CODATA Recommended Values of Fundamental Physical Constants (2018)
IEC 60027-2 Letter symbols to be used in electrical technology

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Calculate deterministic unit conversions between measurement units.

category.description: The category id (e.g. length, mass, temp, volume, area, speed, pressure, energy, power, data, cooking, fuel)

pair.description: Conversion pair slug, e.g. meter-to-feet, kg-to-lbs, celsius-to-fahrenheit, psi-to-bar
